notes: ἐν of ἐν ἀλλήλοις is unrepresented because the ASV compresses the phrase into a possessive, which is rule 36's named case; the unit note gives the competing reading.

'with you' is folded into the compound infinitive as the realization of the συμ- preverb (rule 106); marking it added under rule 103, ὑμῖν being spent on 'in you', remains defensible and is not named in the unit note.
τε takes the written 'both' and καί the written 'and' under rule 70's two-conjunction arm.
